question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes the consequence of having a computer information storage facility.
 
• The structure "has ___________ to" typically requires a verb that signifies causing a result or outcome.
 
• "Led to" means resulted in or caused.
 
• The computer's ability to store information facilitates or causes the collection and storage of personal data.

Thus, the information storage facility the computer provides has led to collection of personal information.

 

Complete Passage with Fillers: *The computer can become a threat to man. It can (1)__endanger__ his survival and privacy. It also offers excellent encouragement for unethical or criminal activities. It can (2)__worsen__ the unemployment problem as employers prefer the computer and the 'computer- controlled robots' to humans for obvious reasons. The information storage facility the computer provides has (3)__led__ to collection of personal information about individuals and storage of this information in data banks by several employing agencies. If care is not exercised (4)__________ data gathering, data integrity may suffer. That is, questionable or imperfect methods may be employed; as a result, incorrect or incomplete data may be stored, and this (5)____________ become a permanent source and used for any given purpose.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Involved:** "Has involved to" is not a standard English construction.
 
• **Stored:** While the facility stores data, the facility itself doesn't "have stored to" cause the collection.
 
• **Experienced:** A facility cannot "experience" something in this context.
